name: smwmusic-intriguing-lights
title: Intriguing Lights
description:
A complex, noisy, atmospheric piece, partly inspired by the Casio Mario World soundtrack. Featuring steady and broken rhythms, glitchy sound effects, swells, different sections and a rich synth chords.
This is not a standard "song", so it's best to be used carefully and intentionally.

Short and long(bigger insert size) versions included.
